summary: City page read (via WebFetch; curl hit Cloudflare): 20 RV sites with 30/50-amp + water, 4 electric tent sites, 60-ft sites, showers, dump, online-only non-refundable booking (2027 opens Feb 2), 2027 season May 7-Oct 5, $33 RV / $22 tent confirmed. No sewer stated.
flags: Pin 44.75700,-94.16000 sits in the crop field south of the park, ~130 m from the campground loops (campers visible on imagery around 44.7580,-94.1608). Under the 250 m bar; move optional.
Not waterfront confirmed: Buffalo Creek runs ~40 m west of the west-loop pads behind a continuous tree band.
